enchantments.tooltip: Freedom of Movement: This item grants its wearer the ability to move and attack normally while under the influence of magic that impedes movement, such as paralysis, solid fog, slow and web.
Insightful Sheltering +21: +21 Insight bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings
Alchemical Earth Attunement: Attacks and offensive spells deal stacking acid damage over time.
Mythic Hands Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
